images.caption: The 'Westertoren' is the highest church tower in Amsterdam (89m), and a landmark structure for this city in Holland (the Netherlands). Building was finished in 1637 and designed by the famous Dutch architect Hendrick de Keyser, but probably finished by Jacob van Kampen in a different shape, this was the tower Anne Frank was able to see from her room in the 'Achterhuis' and chiming of the carillon was a source of comfort to her as mentioned in her diary. The resolution of the original photograph is 3588*7491.
images.alt: The 'Westertoren' is the highest church tower in Amsterdam (89m), and a landmark structure for this city in Holland (the Netherlands). Building was finished in 1637 and designed by the famous Dutch architect Hendrick de Keyser, but probably finished by Jacob van Kampen in a different shape, this was the tower Anne Frank was able to see from her room in the 'Achterhuis' and chiming of the carillon was a source of comfort to her as mentioned in her diary.
